name: Sick Child
overview: Scripture reveals that God is a compassionate Healer who strengthens and cares for the sick, as seen in Psalms 41:3 where the Lord supports the one on a bed of suffering. He is our unshakable refuge and defense in times of weakness (Psalms 62:2). The healing power of God extends beyond physical illness, forgiving iniquities and restoring health (Psalms 103:3). Isaiah 53:5 affirms that through Christ’s suffering and wounds, spiritual and physical healing is made possible, while Isaiah 41:10 encourages believers not to fear, trusting in God's sustaining strength and help amid trials.
